en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
They took out the Chess Guy!
They took out the Test Pilot!
They killed Lash, maybe they're not all bad after all…
They took out the Rat King!
I'll be here all day, mate.
I can work on my abilities.
Need to find time to train.
Need to keep my wits about me.
Don't got any backup, need to be careful.
If they wanna kill me they have to try harder than that…
That was almost was a disaster…
This is going rather badly, isn't it…
This is why I don't like working in groups…
I don't like the looks of this…
We're losing control of this situation…
Always a pleasure workin' with ya…
You're a live one, aren't ya…
Let's see which one of us dies first…
Their streak's come to an end…
We need to be smart, they have the Rejuvenator…
I like the way this is going…
It's nice to fight with people who aren't incompetent…
I haven't felt this good in a long time…
I think things are goin' our way.
This is what I was made for!
Got you where I want you…
You were never going to beat me, Holliday.
I did what I had to do.
She never should have challenged me.
You weren't gonna stop me, Abrams.
No one's getting between me and helping Miss Shelly.
I bet Miss Shelly would have liked her.
She won't be shielding her friends anytime soon.
We don't need to worry about paradox for a while…
Paradox, you're not on my level.
You never fought someone like me, Paradox.
I need to remember to cancel Miss Shelly's brunch at The Baroness.
The Doorman is out of the fight.
What do I look like, Drifter? A frail organic?
Picked the wrong side to back, Dynamo…
No black holes for you, Professor.
Wish we were fighting together, Dynamo.
Don't think Miss Shelly would approve of that one.
That little guy didn't have a chance in hell.
What the hell was that thing?
Nuh uh, sorry Rem, not really into napping.
Well he was a bit much.
He's got Lash's ego without Lash's talent.
Looks like that fancy school never taught you how to win a fight.
A high school fencing tournament isn't the same thing as a real fight, Apollo.
You brought a sword to fight a golem, not as bright as I thought.
Pity she's not working with us.
Well, Fairfax Industries is down an engineer.
Bet she could have given me a tune up…
So much for asking her to speak to Miss Shelly.
McGinnis won't be bothering us for a while.
You aren't standing in my way, Victor.
I'm sorry for your pain, Victor.
You're good, Haze, but you're not me.
It don't matter how big ya are, I'll take anyone to task…
Your freeze ray was never gonna get the job done, mate.
Nothing personal, Kelvin, but you had to go.
Tunnel rats have been dealt with…
You two are tough, just not tough enough.
I'm better than you, Lash, just deal with it.
You see that? I killed Lash. I. Killed. Lash.
Like I told you, lash. beating me was a fluke.
I'm not some organic that's easy to kill.
That girl needs a hug from her parents.
Little too old for the vengeance game, aren't you, mate?
He was like a budget version of Lash.
I tire of people like him.
Your knives were never gonna be enough.
Spend less time on your hair and more time learning how to fight.
There's always someone tougher than you, Shiv, remember that…
She was tougher than she looked.
She had a big heart, but it wasn't enough.
You know, I'm starting to think that she might actually be a unicorn.
There's always someone better than you, Mina.
A little humility would do her wonders.
Mina, you weren't ready to face someone like me.
I can't believe she lasted this long without being stabbed and left for dead in a gutter.
Slink back to the Deep, will ya?
That cube was never gonna save you from me.
Viscous won't be bothering us for a while…
She put up a hell of a fight.
Not the first time I knocked the snot out of a werewolf.
I've fought tougher in the Bear Pit.
Fall on your sword, Yamato… save us all some time.
I'm not getting cut up by the likes of you!
You don't have a chance in hell.
Take a look at me now, Lash. Take a look at me!
Lash wishes he could be this good.
If you think I'm gonna slow down I got bad news for ya…
What's a matter organics? Can't hang with ol' Bebop?
I got hooks for all of ya…
You wanted to fight me? Well here I am…
Of course I outlived the lot of 'em…
Hard to find good help innit…
Looks like it's just me still standing…
Gotta get back in the fight…
We're gonna win this, and I'm gonna look good doing it…
Can't let the rest of the team have all the fun…
Might wanna pull back a bit…
Do my best mate, but I make no promises
Now I'm not tryin' to cast aspersions, Detective - but in my experience organics don't tend to last long in a fight.
Oh this is gonna be fun…
Don’t see too many cowboys in New York.
Isn't a sheriff just a cowboy with a badge?
You're right that does seem rather counter-intuitive.
Looking forward to working with you Paradox.
Miss Shelly's a fan of music.
Sadly no, these hands aren't exactly delicate.
Shame, thought I found a kindred spirit.
Don't worry professor, if anyone escapes your black hole I'll be sure to pull 'em back in
Miss Shelly stresses the importance of etiquette
I like to think she is.
Your commitment to ordinance is impressive McGinnis.
Oh Miss Shelly doesn't believe in that sort of thing.
Geist… are you Dr. Johann's sister?
Not particularly, beyond a few notable exceptions.
No. She gives me something to fight for.
You're not like the other organics.
I got my eye on you Seven.
When this is over the OSIC isn't going to take me away from Miss Shelly , right?
Don't you kill people in their dreams?
True, I can be a right bastard.
You're the one I read about in the papers, right?
That known associates of John Hathorne and the Friends of Humanity have been winding up dead.
They were shot in the head with a high powered rifle.
That sounds rather intense, I think I'll let you be.
I didn't realize you two were acquainted.
Why couldn't I've been paired up with a bouncer instead of a bartender.
Just worried about Miss Shelly is all.
I'm still a little confused on your condition: are you alive or dead.
Not really. I was summoned into existence by an act of craftsmanship, willpower and sacrifice. There's a clear path that someone could replicate. You're a pseudo corpse with a glowing rock.

Miss Shelly loved reading about your adventures. When you disappeared it was sad thinking about her not being able to read a new one before she died. But now that you're back there's hope for one more story.
Alright boys, when I pull 'em in I need you to be ready to grab 'em
Thanks mate, that might have been my last night.
All goes well today I won't need to fight in the pit anymore
Of course the Patron has us working together…

At some point during the ritual you're going to do something outrageously stupid and I'm going to save your life. And I want you to know that when I do, I'm going to lord it over you for the rest of your days.
My love for Miss Shelly is more than my hate for you. We're gonna win this thing… I just hope you die in the process.
You care about Nashala's safety, right?
Then why are you taking her into a fight?
If it means saving Miss Shelly, I'll take 'em all on myself.
How do you like our chances?
I'm not interested in killing people for money.
It's an arbitrary, yet distinct line.
If I bring them to us, can you finish them off?
I'm not sure why you'd think it would be any different from working with a person.
Yeah. Seems like a lot of people are scared of you.
It true you were in The Baxter Society?
Bet you have a lot of stories.
I've found that pit fighting is two parts violence, one part theatrics. You should give it a try sometime, bet you'd be a natural.
You think some knives are really gonna be enough?
When I pull 'em in, you're gonna have to work fast.
Pocket… I don't mean to pry, but if after the ritual you need a place to stay…
Might be a little too heavy for you, Miss.
Why do you fight people for free?
That sounds rather nice Ivy, thank you.
You what, she might. After the ritual, come over to say hi. I'll make biscuits.
Hey Viscous. I'm not organic, why does the cube heal me?
Helping Miss Shelly's never a waste of time.
If today goes well, I won't have a reason to fight.
Would you mind coming over to read to Miss Shelly sometime? I think she'd enjoy it
I'm not trying to be rude, but you don't strike me as a particularly violent person.
Well if he's anything like you, I'm sure he's a good person.
Looks like you have your hands full.
Apologies, normally I would offer to help carry your books for you but I'm afraid need my hands for murderous intent
That's rather kind of you, thank you.
Well, that's what the patrons are for mate…
So what do you plan on doing once I pull them in?
That kind of defeats the purpose of me pulling them in, right?
This isn't going to go well is it.
You look a little rough around the edges, mate
In that case you should come over to the scrap yard after the ritual. I'm sure Miss Shelly could help out with dinner.
I'll pull 'em in close to you Drifter
How long are you planning on being in New York?
Um like have aspirations, or see things when they sleep?
Sorry mate, is what it is.
Well if all goes well, you'll get the chance.
Given the sword I'm assuming you like to be up close?
Good. I'll bring them to us, you finish 'em off.
You'd probably get your ass kicked.
It's not a knock on you, I'm sure you're a helluva talent. But fighting for points is very different than fighting to eat.
Miss Shelly is a good woman.
After the ritual I could introduce you to -
No imposition. I insist. People like us need to stick together.
I'm sorry you don’t know who made you.
You've been talking to Pocket, haven't you.
I'm not trying to be rude, but how much of you is… original you. Well not original per se but-
Your parents know you're out here?
I'm a little older than you, Miss.
I'd do anything for her. I imagine you feel the same way about your parents.
Appreciate the heads up, I'll make it work.
I don't think I've ever seen a priest like you before.
Father, I'm not a religious man. Not a man at all, really. But… would you mind saying a prayer for Miss Shelly?
That was significantly more violent than I expected.
Lay your traps Father, I'll be sure to pull them right towards them.
Shut your mouth Billy. I'm not in the mood.
Mate, I got a bloody laser, what's a bat going to do?
How would you like this to work?
That sound's lovely, I'm not sure Miss Shelly's health will allow it though.
That's true, I'm just trying to be polite.
I work in a scrap yard.
Miss Shelly says you shouldn't judge someone based on what they do.
Don't talk about my mother like that.
Do you like being a vampire?
Can't you just skip the salon?
Why would I throw a boomerang?
Ok. So 1, I was created in America. 2, I sound British, not Australian.
That’s a question for her, not me
Me pulling him in gonna be a problem?
Are you supposed to be in prison?
Never seen you in the Bear Pit.
I've been known to bake a biscuit or two for Miss Shelly, why do you ask?
Made snickerdoodles this morning. Quite the nose you got there. Got any other party tricks.
You look like the rough and tumble type.
Yamato, I don’t particularly care if I disappoint you or not. I'm here for Miss Shelly. Not you.
Getting close to me was never gonna work out well for ya…
Nothing like a good ol' fist fight to get the proverbial blood pumping…
There may be too many of 'em…
No point throwing my life away…
Might be time to regroup with the others…
You ain't laying another hand on me…
You messed around, and you found out…
Now what do we have here?
Who would leave these lying around…
If they're gonna drop it, I'm gonna pick it up…
Thought you got the best of me, did ya?
I can't believe I'm losing to organics…
So this is what humility feels like.
This isn't the outcome I was expecting.
What am I not accounting for?
How did I get in this mess?
My creator needs my help, and I won't let her down.
I'll do whatever it takes to save Miss Shelly.
Miss Shelly's a good person, and probably wouldn't condone me participating in bloodsport for money. I however, am not shackled by human morality, and find it a rather entertaining use of my time.
Miss Shelly's taking a nap, I probably got enough time to contact some god-like creature.
People get me all wrong - I'm not interested in violence for violence's sake. I'm interested in violence for money's sake.
A little trouble never hurt anyone…
The only way this day gets any better is if I get to punch Lash in the face.
Ready to start some trouble with me mates.
Who wants to play with Ol' Bebop?
Facing me the last mistake they're gonna make.
Didn't see that coming, did ya?
I should check out the store…
I should pop by the shop.
I can afford some better items.
I wonder what I can afford now…
I can afford a quality relic.
Might be time to spend these souls…
I should check out what I can get at the store…
I can get some top shelf merchandise.
Nothing in the shop I can't afford.
Time to get the best gear out there.
We're gonna complete the ritual in no time…
Another part of the ritual complete…
Fraid I gotta get back to the junk yard
Good. More time for me to work out new ways to hurt Lash.
Can't. Miss Shelly needs my help.
Just promise me you won't work with Lash…
Not the choice I'd make, but hey it's your life…
Miss Shelly's having one of her good days, so I'm gonna spend time with her while I can.
There's work to be done at the junk yard.
You'll be fine without me. Miss Shelly though? She needs me.
I'll give 'em a proper send off.
You ever punch a man a city block? Helluva feeling.
I can't wait to throw hands…
Time to get in a scrap.
The ol' left hand won me a lot of purses.
Sometimes you need a laser. Sometimes you just need your fist.
No one hits harder than me.
There ain't a man alive I can't send flyin'.
If they think they can run away, well, I got a surprise for them…
Nothing beats catching some poor bastard unaware…
Ready to give the ol' metal handshake.
I'll pull 'em all over the battlefield.
I hope I find someone walkin' all by themselves…
Me and my mates are bout to pick a fight.
Now this is how you start a fight.
Sometimes when I put these on people they're like "oh no what can I do" and it's like: nothing mate, you're gonna blow up.
Is stickin' someone with a bomb they can't remove fair? Of course not, if it was I wouldn't be doin' it.
The only thing that makes this better is sendin' em flying before the bomb goes off.
Another thing humans are bad at: surviving explosions.
I love the looks on their faces.
The inevitable is a helluva thing….
A gift from me to them…
I love givin' these to people…
I got enough of these for everyone…
You'd think shooting people with a giant laser would get old, but no it is always satisfying.
I can't wait to fire this thing.
Now THIS is a proper laser.
This'll burn a hole through anyone.
What's not to love about a giant laser.
Let's see 'em stand against something like this…
Now that's how you send a message.
Why don't you play with our Guardian?
Have fun playing with that walker!
You want the patron? Here you go!
I'll take on all of you.
You got somethin' on ya, mate…
Nothin' you can do now, mate.
You can try to run, but it won't help.
Fraid you got yourself a little problem.
I'll cut through all of ya!
They won't be using their tricks for much longer…
Let me deal with their magic…
I'm not worried about their abilities…
Time to get in the thick of it.
Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.
Closed Captioning provided by the Imperial News Network.
Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe!
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Now that was one helluva fight
Don't worry, Miss Shelly, I won't let you down.
I, for one, am looking forward to proving I'm better than Lash.
Stay close to me, I'll be bringing the trouble to us.
I wasn't built for fighting, but I'm damn good at it.
Miss Shelly probably wouldn't approve of what I'm about to do… unfortunately for them she's at home resting.
I've been waiting for this moment…
Got the ol' death ray primed and ready…
Ready to melt some faces off…
